question: Estimate monthly sales of premium chocolates (₹100+ bar) in Mumbai.
idealClarificationQuestions: Premium chocolate (Lindt, Ferrero Rocher, Cadbury Silk Bubbly+, Toblerone, Hershey premium)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Mumbai HH ₹15L+ income: ~3-3.5 lakh (top affluent + UHNI).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total premium chocolate buying HHs: ~8 lakh.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Plus gifting (Diwali / Valentine's spikes): ~30% extra annualized.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Plus mid-affluent occasionally buying premium chocolate
Average premium chocolate purchase per HH per month

calculationFlow: Mumbai HH ₹15L+ income: ~3-3.5 lakh (top affluent + UHNI).
Plus mid-affluent occasionally buying premium chocolate: ~5 lakh HH.
Total premium chocolate buying HHs: ~8 lakh.
Average premium chocolate purchase per HH per month: ~2 bars/boxes at ₹150 avg = ₹300/month.
Monthly premium chocolate value: 8L × ₹300 = ~₹24 Cr (₹300 Cr/year).
